  nm <- readRDS(name_map_path)
  cat("Name-map entries:", nrow(nm), "\n")
  cat("Resolved        :", sum(!is.na(nm$sp_ncbi_canonical)), "\n")
  cat("Unresolved      :", sum( is.na(nm$sp_ncbi_canonical)), "\n")

  cat("Name map not found — phylogeny not yet built.\n")
}
